title: Sandbox — Neo Terra Free Play
premise: The base Neo Terra world without a season script. No canon beats, no final deadline, no predetermined main threat. Pick any character, choose a starting point, and let the city react.
toneNotes: Flexible. The Director keeps the setting's tone — cyberpunk superhero melodrama — but does not push a season arc. Threats may be introduced by the player or improvised by the narrator as ordinary city trouble.
